title: Research sprint goal: Sessions steer each other through coord asks, and the orchestrator's chores fail clearly
goal: The sprint goal's open questions are answered with the kb tools first and the live docs for the gaps, and the findings are written as kb facts and gap entries through the kb skills, so each committed item can name the knowledge it needs. Tested rows for kb/_self/_retrieval/lookup_eval.csv are a code-lane path (_tools/kblane.py): a story finished with them lands through backlog.py land ID --wait-merge SECONDS, not done --commit.
notes: Open questions for this sprint (kb first, then live docs): No outside facts expected beyond Claude Code's hook output limits (SessionStart additionalContext, kb/public/claude/hooks.md) and git's transient fetch errors; confirm each with rag.py pack and record the kb lines in the item notes, else close with 'no outside facts needed'. Kb lines checked with rag.py pack: kb/public/claude/hooks.md:85 (a hook's additionalContext, systemMessage and plain stdout are each capped at 10,000 characters; longer output is saved to a file and replaced by its path and a 2,000-character preview), hooks.md:82 (SessionStart stdout and additionalContext reach Claude before the first prompt); kb/public/gitlab/git-trailers-and-hooks.md:48 (git fetch of a missing ref ends with fatal: couldn't find remote ref, die exits 128), kb/public/gitlab/automated-merge-requests.md:53 (over HTTP a failed ref discovery ends with fatal: unable to access '<url>': <error>). The kb has no list of which git fetch failures are transient; the sprint's retry-once treats any failed fetch alike, so no such list is needed. No outside facts: every question the sprint goal opens is answered by those kb lines or by the repository's own code, and the live docs hold nothing the items need.
